execution: Offline cached model on local CPU; no source text transmitted elsewhere.
method: Eight queries per document; overlapping 160-word chunks stepped 128 words; top four distinct pages per query.
limitations: Similarity is a retrieval lead, not proof of source facts, dates, approvals, identity, beneficiary geography or complete archives. The results contain page numbers and scores, not raw passage text.
